workplaceInjury.name: WCB Alberta

appealLevels.name: Dispute Resolution and Decision Review Body (DRDRB)
appealLevels.notes: First level review of WCB decisions. Submit within 30 days of decision.

appealLevels.name: Appeals Commission
appealLevels.body: Appeals Commission for Alberta Workers' Compensation
appealLevels.notes: Independent appeal body. Submit within 24 months of DRDRB decision.

workplaceInjury.notes: WCB Alberta administers workplace injury benefits. Two-tier appeal: DRDRB, then Appeals Commission. DRE (Disability Re-Evaluation) process assesses permanent impairments.

humanRights.name: Alberta Human Rights Commission
humanRights.notes: File complaint within 12 months of last incident.

benefitPrograms.name: Assured Income for the Severely Handicapped
benefitPrograms.description: Income and health benefits for Albertans with severe, permanent disabilities preventing substantial employment.
evidenceTips: Medical evidence of severe, permanent disability
Documentation disability prevents substantial gainful employment
